test_title: PYST 26: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Karuna, Jyoti, Shiv, Ram, Puran, Om and Luv are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. Shiv sits third to the left of Luv. Karuna sits second to the left of Shiv. Jyoti sits third to the right of Puran. Ram sits second to the right of Jyoti. Ram is not an immediate neighbour of Shiv. Who sits to the immediate left of Ram?
solution:
Given: Karuna, Jyoti, Shiv, Ram, Puran, Om and Luv are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

1) Shiv sits third to the left of Luv. 

2) Karuna sits second to the left of Shiv.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a100c1eefa168c0f8f9dfcff8f5362497cf2ccfd363c0e85b569aceb0e3f91c1.png] 

3) Ram sits second to the right of Jyoti.

4) Ram is not an immediate neighbour of Shiv. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/995d0868b374a6d59881663f75b2f4b8a5d0188dab66fb252f586d8c449a367d.png] 

5) Jyoti sits third to the right of Puran.

After positioning Puran only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. Om.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b76848ba4215b17ab6718763a795a6632faa7cc1aa4a23c6bc515c3a13d86ed.png] 

Thus, Luv sits to the immediate left of Ram.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
